clue.text: Valuable info about antique

indicators.note: one word goes about, or around, the other, wrapping it on both sides

blocks.note: gen is British slang for information

explanation.surface: A dealer passes on useful information about an antique piece.
explanation.walkthrough: Gen is British slang for information, as in getting the gen on something.
explanation.definitionFit: Something golden is precious, like the metal itself, so it carries great worth.

clue.text: Satellite linking Georgia, New York, Maine and Delaware

standard abbreviation for New York
postal abbreviation for Maine
postal abbreviation for Delaware

explanation.definitionFit: Ganymede is the largest moon of Jupiter, a natural satellite of that planet.

clue.text: E-mailed furiously about Tesla delivery schedule

indicators.note: acting furiously means flailing wildly, so the letters of the email word are thrown about
the scrambled word goes about, or around, the single letter for Tesla

blocks.note: the word itself, as fodder for rearranging
T is the symbol for the tesla, the unit of magnetic flux density

explanation.surface: Someone angrily emails the carmaker Tesla about when their car will arrive.
explanation.walkthrough: Tesla looks like the carmaker, but here it is the unit of magnetic flux density, abbreviated T.
explanation.definitionFit: Lead time is the interval between placing an order and its arrival, so it governs a delivery timetable.

clue.text: Me? I’m slob — silly, troublesome clot

indicators.note: something silly is muddled and nonsensical, so the preceding letters are put in a new order

blocks.note: the letters of these three words are the fodder

explanation.walkthrough: Clot looks like the British insult for a fool, matching slob and silly; here it is a blood clot.
explanation.definitionFit: An embolism is a blockage of a blood vessel, often caused by a clot travelling through the bloodstream.

clue.text: Figure, Republican, one in mess?

Roman numeral one

explanation.definitionFit: A triangle is a three-sided shape, a basic geometric figure.

clue.text: Remarkably well, bloody lovely on vacation!

explanation.walkthrough: Bloody looks like British slang for very; here it describes underdone meat, RARE.

clue.text: Accumulate brilliant French vintage in stock

explanation.walkthrough: A cru is a French vineyard or wine of classified quality, as in grand cru.
explanation.definitionFit: To accrue is to build up or gather gradually over time, as interest or debts do.

clue.text: Comprehensive target to include Liberal and bishop

clue.text: English flower festival

the aster is a daisy-like garden flower

clue.text: New Listener and Times to hand

times as in multiplication, as in three by four

clue.text: Commodities Exchange speculator is me

the opening letter of indie

explanation.definitionFit: Iridium is one of the densest chemical elements, a hard, heavy platinum-group metal.

clue.text: Cook whitebait

explanation.definitionFit: The word is both a verb for cooking in oil and a noun for very young fish, of which whitebait is an example.

clue.text: Clear screen, start to delete various items

the word itself, as fodder for rearranging

blocks.note: the second, fourth and sixth letters

clue.text: Banal, boring Dortmund — an eyesore

clue.text: Stick a fork in Julius’s pasty

explanation.definitionFit: To impale is to pierce or skewer something on a sharp point, as a fork's tines do.

clue.text: Sends unwanted messages involving the onset of sudden contractions

the opening letter of sudden
